edit.summary:
I proposed three changes to the `delivery` declaration. All three came back with no issues, and they are still waiting for review.

- **`objects.DeliveryRequest`:** I added a required `branch` string fact. I left everything else on the object as it was.
- **`actions.request_delivery`:** I added a required `branch` param and said in the description that a request without it is refused. The refusal comes from the param being required. I did not add a separate precondition. A request that has `branch` but leaves it empty may therefore still get through.
- **`world.fixtures`:** I added `branch: main` to R1–R4. Without it they would no longer match the object, since `branch` is now required.

I did not add a rule that only `main` can be delivered. The request only asks that the branch be known. The glossary already says the deploy floor requires "on main".

The declaration I read differs from the generated guide. It uses stage `built` where the guide says `previewed`. I kept `built` as the declaration has it.
